DA_LE_compute_resolve_max = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max which = DA_LE_n }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max value = 10 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 1 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_q_morale }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max which = DA_LE_tmp }
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_ruler_leads }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max value = 40 }
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { adm = 1 NOT = { adm = 2 } } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max value = 10 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { adm = 2 NOT = { adm = 3 } } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max value = 20 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { adm = 3 NOT = { adm = 4 } } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max value = 30 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { adm = 4 NOT = { adm = 5 } } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max value = 40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { adm = 5 NOT = { adm = 6 } } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max value = 50 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { adm = 6 NOT = { adm = 7 } } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max value = 60 }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_levels value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_ruler_flag = abjuration_1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_ruler_flag = abjuration_2 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_ruler_flag = abjuration_3 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 3 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_levels which = DA_LE_tmp }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_ruler_flag = conjuration_1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_ruler_flag = conjuration_2 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 2 }
		}
		if = {

		}

		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_ruler_flag = divination_1 } }

		}
		if = {

		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_levels which = DA_LE_tmp }

		if = {

		}

		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 0 }

			limit = { owner = { has_ruler_flag = necromancy_1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_ruler_flag = necromancy_2 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 2 }
		}
		if = {

		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_levels which = DA_LE_tmp }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_ruler_flag = transmutation_1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_ruler_flag = transmutation_2 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_ruler_flag = transmutation_3 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 3 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_levels which = DA_LE_tmp }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_levels }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 12 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max which = DA_LE_tmp }
	}
}

# What the announced move does against the order we gave (and the spell we cast).
DA_LE_load_move = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_might value = 1 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 1 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_gain value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_heal value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_fear value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_lich = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_move_1 }
			# Raises the Fallen
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_might value = 0.9 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_assault }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 1.25 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_gain value = 70 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_shield }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 0.55 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_gain value = 140 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_volley }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_gain value = 140 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_loose }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 0.85 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_gain value = 140 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_necromancy }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_gain value = 0 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_move_2 }
			# Wail of the Grave
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_might value = 2 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_assault }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 1.25 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_shield }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_volley }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_loose }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 0.35 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_move_3 }
			# Soul Drain
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_might value = 1.1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_assault }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 1.25 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_heal value = 90 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_shield }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 0.55 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_volley }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_heal value = 90 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_loose }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 0.85 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_heal value = 90 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_abjuration }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_heal value = 0 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_move_4 }
			# Rebuilds the Wards
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_might value = 0.3 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_assault }

				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1.4 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_gain value = 55 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_shield }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 0.55 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_gain value = 220 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_volley }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1.2 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_gain value = 132 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_loose }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 0.85 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_gain value = 220 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_dragon = yes }

			}

				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 0.55 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_volley }

				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }

		if = {

			}

				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_shield }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 0.7 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_volley }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 0.7 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_loose }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_in value = 0.85 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_out value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

DA_LE_roll_die = {
	random_list = {
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 1 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 2 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 3 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 4 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 5 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 6 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 7 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 8 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 9 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 10 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 11 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 12 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 13 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 14 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 15 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 16 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 17 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 18 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 19 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_$die$ value = 20 } }
	}
}

# Never the same move twice in a row.
DA_LE_roll_move = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_next_1
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_next_2
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_next_3
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_next_4
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_lich = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_move_1 } NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_move_2 } NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_move_3 } NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_move_4 }
			}
			random_list = {
				30 = { set_province_flag = DA_LE_next_1 }
				25 = { set_province_flag = DA_LE_next_2 }
				25 = { set_province_flag = DA_LE_next_3 }
				20 = { set_province_flag = DA_LE_next_4 }
			}
		}

			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_move_1 }
			random_list = {

DA_LE_spell_value = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LE_lvl value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_val value = $l1$ }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LE_lvl value = 2 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_val value = $l2$ }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LE_lvl value = 3 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_val value = $l3$ }
	}
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_val which = DA_LE_m }
}

DA_LE_cap_val = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_val value = $cap$ } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_val value = $cap$ }
	}
}

# Sets DA_LE_lvl and DA_LE_m and the flag DA_LE_cast_<school>; the battle mages pay their mana here.
DA_LE_cast_school = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_r value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_e value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_ruler_leads }
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_ruler_flag = $school$_1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_r value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_ruler_flag = $school$_2 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_r value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_ruler_flag = $school$_3 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_r value = 3 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_has_battle_mages = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = $school$_1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_e value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = $school$_2 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_e value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = $school$_3 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_e value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LE_e value = 3 }
				NOT = { owner = { check_variable = { which = currentMana value = 50 } } }
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_e value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LE_e value = 2 }
				NOT = { owner = { check_variable = { which = currentMana value = 30 } } }
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_e value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LE_e value = 1 }
				NOT = { owner = { check_variable = { which = currentMana value = 15 } } }
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_e value = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_r }
	change_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 2 }
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_ruler
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_estate
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = DA_LE_r value = 1 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_e which = DA_LE_tmp } }
		}
		set_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_ruler
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = DA_LE_e value = 1 }
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_ruler }
		}
		set_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_estate
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_ruler }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_lvl which = DA_LE_r }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_m value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { mil = 1 NOT = { mil = 2 } } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_m value = 0.04 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { mil = 2 NOT = { mil = 3 } } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_m value = 0.08 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { mil = 3 NOT = { mil = 4 } } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_m value = 0.12 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { mil = 4 NOT = { mil = 5 } } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_m value = 0.16 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { mil = 5 NOT = { mil = 6 } } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_m value = 0.2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { mil = 6 NOT = { mil = 7 } } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_m value = 0.24 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_has_battle_mages = yes }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_m value = 0.1 }
		}
		set_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_$school$
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_estate }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_lvl which = DA_LE_e }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_m value = 0.6 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LE_e value = 1 } }
			owner = { change_mana = { amount = -15 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LE_e value = 2 } }
			owner = { change_mana = { amount = -30 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LE_e value = 3 } }
			owner = { change_mana = { amount = -50 } }
		}
		set_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_$school$
	}
}

DA_LE_pick_caster = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_lvl value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_m value = 0 }
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_ruler
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_estate
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_abjuration
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_conjuration
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_divination
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_enchantment
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_evocation
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_illusion
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_necromancy
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_transmutation
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_abjuration
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_abjuration }
		}
		DA_LE_cast_school = { school = abjuration }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_conjuration
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_conjuration }
		}
		DA_LE_cast_school = { school = conjuration }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_divination
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_divination }
		}
		DA_LE_cast_school = { school = divination }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_enchantment
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_enchantment }
		}
		DA_LE_cast_school = { school = enchantment }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_evocation
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_evocation }
		}
		DA_LE_cast_school = { school = evocation }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_illusion
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_illusion }
		}
		DA_LE_cast_school = { school = illusion }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_necromancy
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_necromancy }
		}
		DA_LE_cast_school = { school = necromancy }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_transmutation
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_transmutation }
		}
		DA_LE_cast_school = { school = transmutation }
	}
}

# One round. Called from the round event after the three dice are rolled; the order is the flag DA_LE_order_<id>.
# check_legendary_encounters.py runs this against resolve_round() in le_rules.py.
DA_LE_resolve_round = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_rep_missed
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_rep_ambush
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_rep_revived
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_rep_healed
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_dead
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_will_revive
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_won
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_lost_fight
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_stalemate
	DA_LE_count_army = yes
	DA_LE_pick_caster = yes
	DA_LE_load_legend = yes
	DA_LE_load_move = yes

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_divination
			is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LE_lvl value = 1 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_a value = 10 } }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_a value = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_divination
			is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LE_lvl value = 2 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_a value = 15 } }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_a value = 15 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_divination
			is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LE_lvl value = 3 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_a value = 20 } }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_die_a value = 20 }
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_var_ours which = DA_LE_die_a }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_var_ours value = 0.015 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_LE_var_ours value = 0.85 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_var_theirs which = DA_LE_die_b }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_var_theirs value = 0.015 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_LE_var_theirs value = 0.85 }

	# our blow
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_assault }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_s_melee }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_army value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_s_art }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 0.6 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_tmp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_shield }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_s_melee }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_army value = 0.45 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_s_art }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 0.45 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_tmp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_volley }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_s_melee }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_army value = 0.2 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_s_art }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 1.6 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_tmp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_order_loose }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_s_melee }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_army value = 0.65 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_s_art }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 0.65 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_tmp }
	}
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_mv_out }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_enchantment } }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_mv_fear }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_enchantment }
		DA_LE_spell_value = { l1 = 0.2 l2 = 0.35 l3 = 0.5 }
		DA_LE_cap_val = { cap = 0.9 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_val value = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_val }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_conjuration }
		DA_LE_spell_value = { l1 = 20 l2 = 40 l3 = 60 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_val }
	}
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_var_ours }
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_divination }
		DA_LE_spell_value = { l1 = 0.1 l2 = 0.2 l3 = 0.3 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_val value = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_val }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_divination } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 1 }
		subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_armor }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_army which = DA_LE_tmp }
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_spell_dmg value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_evocation }
		DA_LE_spell_value = { l1 = 40 l2 = 75 l3 = 120 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 1 }
		subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_resist }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_val which = DA_LE_tmp }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_spell_dmg which = DA_LE_val }
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_vuln value = 1 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_LE_vuln which = DA_LE_sunder }
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_weakness_known = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_vuln value = 0.15 }
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_total which = DA_LE_army }
	change_variable = { which = DA_LE_total which = DA_LE_spell_dmg }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_total which = DA_LE_vuln }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_rep_dealt which = DA_LE_total }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_rep_warded value = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_divination }
		subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp which = DA_LE_total }
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_left which = DA_LE_ward }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_left which = DA_LE_total }
	# left = what remains of the ward; below zero it is what goes through
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_divination }
			check_variable = { which = DA_LE_left value = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_rep_warded which = DA_LE_total }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward which = DA_LE_left }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_divination }
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_left value = 0 } }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_rep_warded which = DA_LE_ward }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward value = 0 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp which = DA_LE_left }
	}

	# lasting spells
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_necromancy }
		DA_LE_spell_value = { l1 = 8 l2 = 15 l3 = 24 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_val which = DA_LE_necro }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 1 }
		subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_resist }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_val which = DA_LE_tmp }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_rot which = DA_LE_val }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_rot value = 90 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_rot value = 90 }
		}
	}
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp which = DA_LE_rot }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_rep_rot which = DA_LE_rot }
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_transmutation }
		DA_LE_spell_value = { l1 = 0.08 l2 = 0.14 l3 = 0.2 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LE_sunder which = DA_LE_val }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_sunder value = 0.5 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_sunder value = 0.5 }
		}
	}

	# is it dead?
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp value = 0.001 } } }
		set_province_flag = DA_LE_dead
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_dead
			check_variable = { which = DA_LE_revive value = 1 }
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_revived }
			NOT = { DA_LE_weakness_known = yes }
		}
		set_province_flag = DA_LE_will_revive
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_dead
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_will_revive }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp value = 0 }
		set_province_flag = DA_LE_won
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_will_revive }
		set_province_flag = DA_LE_revived
		set_province_flag = DA_LE_rep_revived
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp which = DA_LE_revive }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_won } }
		# its move
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_rep_revived } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward which = DA_LE_mv_gain }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward which = DA_LE_ward_max } }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward which = DA_LE_ward_max }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_mv_heal value = 1 } }
				change_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp which = DA_LE_mv_heal }
				set_province_flag = DA_LE_rep_healed
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp which = DA_LE_hp_max } }
					set_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp which = DA_LE_hp_max }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_incoming which = DA_LE_might }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_incoming which = DA_LE_mv_might }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_incoming which = DA_LE_mv_in }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_incoming which = DA_LE_var_theirs }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_enrage_at value = 1 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp which = DA_LE_enrage_at } }
			}
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_incoming which = DA_LE_enrage }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_abjuration }
			DA_LE_spell_value = { l1 = 0.3 l2 = 0.5 l3 = 0.7 }
			DA_LE_cap_val = { cap = 0.85 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 1 }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_val }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_incoming which = DA_LE_tmp }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_conjuration }
			DA_LE_spell_value = { l1 = 0.1 l2 = 0.15 l3 = 0.2 }
			DA_LE_cap_val = { cap = 0.4 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 1 }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_val }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_incoming which = DA_LE_tmp }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_illusion }
			DA_LE_spell_value = { l1 = 25 l2 = 40 l3 = 55 }
			DA_LE_cap_val = { cap = 80 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_die_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_val which = DA_LE_tmp } }
				set_variable = { which = DA_LE_incoming value = 0 }
				set_province_flag = DA_LE_rep_missed
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_ambush }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_incoming value = 0 }
			clr_province_flag = DA_LE_ambush
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_rep_ambush
		}
		subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve which = DA_LE_incoming }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_rep_taken which = DA_LE_incoming }

		# a school needs a round to settle before it can be cast again
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_abjuration
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_conjuration
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_divination
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_enchantment
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_evocation
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_illusion
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_necromancy
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_transmutation
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_abjuration }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_abjuration
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_conjuration }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_conjuration
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_divination }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_divination
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_enchantment }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_enchantment
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_evocation }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_evocation
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_illusion }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_illusion
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_necromancy }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_necromancy
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cast_transmutation }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_transmutation
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve value = 0.001 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve value = 0 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_lost_fight
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_lost_fight }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_round value = 15 }
			}
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_stalemate
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_lost_fight }
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_stalemate }
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_LE_round value = 1 }
			DA_LE_roll_move = yes
		}
	}

	set_province_flag = DA_LE_rep_any
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_abjuration
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_conjuration
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_divination
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_enchantment
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_evocation
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_illusion
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_necromancy
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_transmutation
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_order_assault
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_order_shield
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_order_volley
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_order_loose
	divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_rep_dealt value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_rep_dealt value = 1000 }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_rep_warded value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_rep_warded value = 1000 }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_rep_rot value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_rep_rot value = 1000 }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_rep_taken value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_rep_taken value = 1000 }
	DA_LE_update_show = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_won }
		DA_LE_end_victory = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_lost_fight }
		DA_LE_end_defeat = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_stalemate }
		DA_LE_end_withdraw = yes
	}
}

DA_LE_update_show = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp_show which = DA_LE_hp }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp_show value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp_show value = 1000 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward_show which = DA_LE_ward }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward_show value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward_show value = 1000 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_show which = DA_LE_resolve }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_show value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_show value = 1000 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max_show which = DA_LE_resolve_max }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max_show value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max_show value = 1000 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp_max_show which = DA_LE_hp_max }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp_max_show value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp_max_show value = 1000 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp_pct value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp_max value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp_pct which = DA_LE_hp }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp_pct value = 100 }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp_pct which = DA_LE_hp_max }
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_pct value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_pct which = DA_LE_resolve }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_pct value = 100 }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_pct which = DA_LE_resolve_max }
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward_pct value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward_max value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward_pct which = DA_LE_ward }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward_pct value = 100 }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward_pct which = DA_LE_ward_max }
	}
	set_variable = { which = currentMana which = owner }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_mana_show which = currentMana }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_mana_show value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_mana_show value = 1000 }
}

# Brings the numbers in the window up to date. Safe to call at any time.
DA_LE_refresh = {
	DA_LE_load_legend = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_hp_init } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp which = DA_LE_hp_start }
		set_province_flag = DA_LE_hp_init
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_ruler_leads
			NOT = { DA_LE_ruler_can_lead = yes }
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_engaged }
		}
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_ruler_leads
	}
	DA_LE_count_army = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_engaged } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_ward which = DA_LE_ward_start }
		DA_LE_compute_resolve_max = yes
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve which = DA_LE_resolve_max }
	}
	DA_LE_update_show = yes
}

	remove_province_modifier = DA_LE_contained_dragon

	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_conjuration
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_divination
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_enchantment

			DA_LE_is_dragon = yes
			DA_LE_weakness_known = yes

		set_province_flag = DA_LE_ambush

	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_LE_is_hunter = yes
			DA_LE_weakness_known = yes
		}
		set_province_flag = DA_LE_ambush
	}
	set_province_flag = DA_LE_engaged
	province_event = { id = DA_legendary_encounter.1 }
}

# Regiments lost = regiments x share of resolve lost x $share$, infantry first.
DA_LE_casualties = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_lost value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_resolve_max value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_resolve }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_resolve_max }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_lost value = 1 }
		subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_lost which = DA_LE_tmp }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_lost which = DA_LE_n }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = $share$ }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_lost which = DA_LE_tmp }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_LE_lost value = 1000 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_lost value = 1000 }
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_last_lost which = DA_LE_lost }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_last_rounds which = DA_LE_round }
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_killed
	owner = {
		PREV = {
			while = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_lost value = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_killed }
						check_variable = { which = DA_LE_inf value = 1 }
					}
					kill_units = { who = PREV type = infantry amount = 1 }
					subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_inf value = 1 }
					set_province_flag = DA_LE_killed
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_killed }
						check_variable = { which = DA_LE_cav value = 1 }
					}
					kill_units = { who = PREV type = cavalry amount = 1 }
					subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_cav value = 1 }
					set_province_flag = DA_LE_killed
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_killed }
						check_variable = { which = DA_LE_art value = 1 }
					}
					kill_units = { who = PREV type = artillery amount = 1 }
					subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_art value = 1 }
					set_province_flag = DA_LE_killed
				}
				clr_province_flag = DA_LE_killed
				subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_lost value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	owner = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_last_lost which = PREV }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_last_rounds which = PREV }
	}
}

# A legend that drives us off keeps part of its wounds.
DA_LE_keep_wounds = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_hp_max }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp which = DA_LE_hp }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_LE_tmp value = 0.5 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_LE_hp which = DA_LE_tmp }
}

DA_LE_end_victory = {
	DA_LE_casualties = { share = 0.35 }
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_lich = yes }
		owner = { country_event = { id = DA_Verkal_Kozenad_event.4 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_dragon = yes }
		owner = { country_event = { id = DA_Khugdihr_event.2 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_hunter = yes }
		owner = { country_event = { id = DA_Hold_Gor_Vazumbrog.52 } }
		set_province_flag = DA_Hunter_gone
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_gatewarden = yes }
		owner = { country_event = { id = DA_Remaining_Holds_event.12 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_maze_guest = yes }
		owner = { country_event = { id = DA_Remaining_Holds_event.22 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_ombrindal = yes }
		owner = { country_event = { id = DA_Remaining_Holds_event.32 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_dream = yes }
		owner = { country_event = { id = DA_Remaining_Wonders_event.242 } }
	}
	DA_LE_stop_fight = yes
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_hp_init
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_scouting
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_weakness_given
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_ruler_leads
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_seen
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_open
	set_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 0 }
}

DA_LE_end_defeat = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_LE_fled
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_flees = yes }
		set_province_flag = DA_LE_fled
	}
	DA_LE_casualties = { share = 0.7 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_fled } }
		DA_LE_keep_wounds = yes
		add_province_modifier = { name = DA_LE_regroup duration = 365 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_ruler_leads }
		owner = { set_country_flag = DA_LE_ruler_led }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_lich = yes }
		owner = { country_event = { id = DA_legendary_encounter.102 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_dragon = yes }
		owner = { country_event = { id = DA_legendary_encounter.202 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_hunter = yes }
		owner = { country_event = { id = DA_legendary_encounter.302 } }
		set_province_flag = DA_Hunter_gone
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_gatewarden = yes }
		owner = { country_event = { id = DA_legendary_encounter.402 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_maze_guest = yes }
		owner = { country_event = { id = DA_legendary_encounter.502 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_ombrindal = yes }
		owner = { country_event = { id = DA_legendary_encounter.602 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_dream = yes }
		owner = { country_event = { id = DA_legendary_encounter.702 } }
	}
	DA_LE_stop_fight = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_fled } }
		DA_LE_refresh = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_fled }
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_hp_init
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_scouting
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_weakness_given
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_ruler_leads
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_seen
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_open
		set_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 0 }
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_fled
	}
}

		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_fled
	}
}

DA_LE_scout = {
	owner = { add_treasury = -200 }
	set_province_flag = DA_LE_scouting
}

DA_LE_contain = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_lich = yes }
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 } }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -400 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 } }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -600 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 3 } }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -800 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 3 }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -1000 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		add_province_modifier = { name = DA_LE_contained_lich duration = 3650 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_dragon = yes }
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 } }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -500 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 } }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -750 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 3 } }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -1000 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 3 }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -1500 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		add_province_modifier = { name = DA_LE_contained_dragon duration = 3650 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_maze_guest = yes }
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 } }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -300 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 } }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -450 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 3 } }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -600 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		if = {

				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 3 }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -800 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		add_province_modifier = { name = DA_LE_contained_maze_guest duration = 3650 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_is_dream = yes }
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 } }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -200 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 } }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -300 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 3 } }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -400 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_paid }
				check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 3 }
			}
			owner = { add_treasury = -500 }
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		}
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_paid
		add_province_modifier = { name = DA_LE_contained_dream duration = 3650 }
	}
	change_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 }
}

DA_LE_five_year_pulse = {
	# raids of a legend that is neither dead nor contained
	if = {
		limit = {
			owns = 2863
			2863 = { DA_LE_is_dragon = yes NOT = { DA_LE_contained = yes } NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_engaged } }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 40
			country_event = { id = DA_Khugdihr_event.4 }
		}
	}
	# the AI has no window: once it is strong enough it gets a chance to finish a legend every five years
	if = {
		limit = {
			ai = yes
			owns = 4056
			has_country_flag = DA_can_duel_lich
			mil_tech = 14
			army_size = 30
			4056 = { DA_LE_is_lich = yes }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 35
			add_manpower = -6
			country_event = { id = DA_Verkal_Kozenad_event.4 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			ai = yes
			owns = 2863
			has_country_flag = DA_can_duel_Dragon
			mil_tech = 18
